analyst_view.overall: Slavia are 34th of 36 with 1 point and Villarreal 28th with 3, so both are below the top-24 line and need a win; Slavia have not won a league-phase game since 2007 and likely need three wins from their last four. At home Slavia are in form, top of the Czech league after a 2-0 win at Olomouc on Saturday (their third win in a row), but David Moses went off injured there and Jindřich Trpišovský expects a longer absence (one report). Villarreal visit Barcelona on Sunday before the trip to Prague; Santiago Mouriño's Champions League ban is already counted, while Alassane Diatta is out for months and Gerard Moreno, Juan Foyth and Ilias Akhomach are serious doubts, none of which the numbers list. Those absences on both sides roughly cancel out and no referee is named yet, so the view stays with the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.6 goals (1.2 Slavia, 2.3 Villarreal), already counting Slavia's better recent scoring (+2.6%). Villarreal may be without Gerard Moreno and Foyth and may rotate after Sunday's game at Barcelona, while Slavia lose Moses; with both sides needing a win these pull both ways, so I stay at 3.6.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners, already raised for both sides' recent corner counts (+5% Slavia, +3.5% Villarreal). Slavia attack down the wings with wing-backs and Villarreal like wide play too; losing Moses is a small hit for Slavia's right side but not enough to move, so I stay at 9.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards, already taking off Slavia's unusually low recent card count (-9.1%). Two teams who both need the result can make for a tense game, but there is no history of bad blood and no referee is named yet, so I stay at 4.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.9 shots, already lifted for both sides' heavy recent shooting (+8.9% Slavia, +11.6% Villarreal). Slavia's high-tempo home game fits that picture; Villarreal's possible rotation could cut a little, but nothing is confirmed, so I stay at 30.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 shots on target, already counting Slavia's sharper recent finishing (+7.7%). Without confirmed lineups, and with absences on both sides, I see nothing they miss and stay at 10.1.
